title: Common Errors
markdown:
| Message or symptom | Usual cause | Fix | Lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| Assertion "Missing End()" or "Mismatched Begin/End calls" | `End` was skipped when `Begin` returned false, or an early `return` left a scope open | Always call `End` after `Begin`; pair every `Push` and `Pop` | 1.04 |
| Assertion about the ID stack ("PushID/PopID mismatch") | A `PushID` without a `PopID` on some path | Pop on every path; keep pushes and pops in one function | 1.05 |
| Clicking one button triggers another, or only the first of several works | Several widgets with the same label in the same scope share an ID | `##suffix` or `PushID(i)` around each row | 1.05 |
| A text box loses its contents or focus every frame | Its label changes each frame, so its ID changes | Put the changing part before `###` | 1.05 |
| Nothing appears, but there is no error | `Render` or the backend draw call is missing, or the window is off screen | Check the frame order; delete `imgui.ini` | 1.03 |
| An assertion about `WithinFrameScope` | A widget called outside `NewFrame` ... `Render` | Submit UI only during a frame | 1.03 |
| The game moves when you drag a slider or type in a box | Game input ignores `WantCaptureMouse` and `WantCaptureKeyboard` | Check them before handling input | 2.05 |
| `TreePop` assertion, or children drawn at the wrong indent | `TreePop` called when `TreeNode` returned false, or not at all | Call `TreePop` only inside `if (TreeNode(...))` | 3.04 |
| A long list makes the frame slow | Every row is submitted even when not visible | `ImGuiListClipper` | 3.02 |
| A popup never opens | `OpenPopup` and `BeginPopup` used different IDs, often in different ID scopes | Call both in the same scope with the same string | 4.02 |
| A modal opens and closes at once, or cannot be closed | `OpenPopup` is called every frame | Call it once, on the event | 4.02 |
| Drag and drop does nothing | The payload type strings differ, or the payload is the wrong size | One shared constant for the type; check `DataSize` | 4.03 |
| Docking does not work | `ImGuiConfigFlags_DockingEnable` not set, or the master branch is used instead of the docking branch | Use the docking branch; set the flag | 4.04 |
| Text is blurry or shows "?" boxes | Font loaded at the wrong size, or glyph ranges missing for the characters | Load at the display size; add the ranges you need | 4.05 |
| A font change has no effect | The font was added after the atlas was built | Add fonts before the first frame, or rebuild the atlas | 4.05 |
| Windows reset their layout every start | `IniFilename` is `nullptr`, or the program runs from another folder | Give the ini file a full path | 4.06 |
| A drag creates hundreds of undo steps | One step is recorded per frame of the drag | Record on `IsItemDeactivatedAfterEdit` | 5.04 |
| Stack overflow in a flood fill | Recursive fill on a large region | Explicit stack or queue | 6.01 |
